text: Carbaryl controls external parasites in poultry as a dusting powder, with low toxicity and short persistence; spray the vent and fluff areas from beneath the bird, and the litter surface to control black beetles. Do not repeat treatment more often than every 4 weeks, and do not apply within 7 days of slaughter; 500 g of 5% Carbaryl treats about 100 birds. Asuntol 50 controls ticks, sucking and biting lice, fleas, depluming mites, sucking flies, fly larvae in wounds, and mange mites in domestic animals (except cats); it's a white powder diluted in water (1 g/liter), usable for 6 months once mixed, typically applied by hand-spraying or wash treatment. Asuntol is highly toxic by inhalation or ingestion — poisoning signs include diarrhea, drooling, breathing difficulty, leg/neck stiffness, and dilated eye pupils.
caveat: Product names and availability reflect the source manual (circa 2013) and may have changed; always follow current label instructions and local veterinary guidance.
